group_semantics_correction.prior_statement_corrected: No pure-00 or both windows in an evaluation subset does not imply that all multiple-miss common-group events are absent; mixed groups must not be described uniformly as strengthening report disagreement.
group_semantics_correction.reason: A mixed group with three or more valid sources may contain one report and at least two misses. Under heterogeneous marginals, dependence can reduce or increase the current conditional negative score R=-log(q_all/q_plus).
group_semantics_correction.necessary_followup_scope: Count mixed groups with at least two valid misses separately; existing pure-00 coverage alone cannot resolve this question.
group_semantics_correction.numerical_review_unchanged: This semantic correction does not change the independently verified source joins, weights, Count decisions, or matched R_ind AUC; no data was rescanned for this note.
